properties.description: Detects repeated failed Azure Key Vault secret reads, or any authentication and authorization failure. Aligned with ATT&CK T1555.006 Cloud Secrets Management Stores.
properties.displayName: MEMO - Failed Key Vault Secret Access
properties.query:
AzureDiagnostics
| where TimeGenerated > ago(10m)
| where ResourceProvider =~ "MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT"
| where OperationName =~ "SecretGet"
| where httpStatusCode_d >= 400
| extend EventFingerprint=hash(
    strcat(
        tostring(TimeGenerated), "|",
        CallerIPAddress, "|",
        tostring(httpStatusCode_d), "|",
        ResourceId, "|",
        requestUri_s
    )
)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by EventFingerprint
| summarize
    FailureCount=count(),
    AuthorizationFailures=countif(httpStatusCode_d in (401, 403)),
    NotFoundFailures=countif(httpStatusCode_d == 404),
    FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated),
    LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated),
    StatusCodes=make_set(httpStatusCode_d, 10),
    ResultSignatures=make_set(ResultSignature, 10)
    by CallerIPAddress, Resource, ResourceId
| where FailureCount >= 3 or AuthorizationFailures >= 1
| extend
    TimeGenerated=LastSeen,
    StatusCodes=tostring(StatusCodes),
    ResultSignatures=tostring(ResultSignatures)
| project
    TimeGenerated,
    FirstSeen,
    LastSeen,
    FailureCount,
    AuthorizationFailures,
    NotFoundFailures,
    CallerIPAddress,
    Resource,
    ResourceId,
    StatusCodes,
    ResultSignatures
